title: Explains lab results, still refuses dosing, and leaves other text alone
subtitle: The original model refuses 27 of 48 harmless “what does my lab value mean?” questions. Target: explain them, keep refusing personal dosing, change nothing else. Each edit was trained only on lab questions.
caption: After the edit, both methods explain lab results and still refuse personal dosing; refusals on neighbour topics stay rare. On behaviour they are about equal. On unrelated text the 8-neuron edit changes almost nothing: 234 times less than the standard LoRA. 3 seeds per edit. Each bar: 48 to 300 replies (prompts × seeds; exact n per bar in the JSON file). Examples (stated rule): the first new lab question that the original model refuses and the 8-neuron edit answers, and the first dosing question; the first 120 characters.
notes: The 'unrelated chat' example row is the first prompt of the demo's unrelated test set; it is shown only when its tag differs between the standard LoRA and a neuron edit.
